outlook: Grain futures rallied in Friday's holiday-shortened session after Thanksgiving, led by soybeans, which were roughly 25 cents higher at midday along with gains in soybean meal; corn was up about 7–10 cents and wheat traded higher on all three exchanges, with Kansas City leading. USDA confirmed a private export sale of 132,000 tonnes of soybeans for 2026/27 delivery, adding to steady export demand. Friday settlement prices were not yet available from free sources at update time, so the futures and cash figures shown are still Wednesday's closes (Dec spring wheat $6.41½, Jan soybeans $12.44, Dec corn $4.39¾). Traders are rolling out of December contracts ahead of Monday's first notice day, and Statistics Canada's crop production report follows on Dec 4.
